reviews: Just a lovely place to relax and get some papering

I felt very comfortable with all of the lovely staff members. The only thing in my Groupon that I didn’t get, was the steam shower and honestly, I was happy without it. Everything was amazing. Gina, Anastasia (might be spelled wrong-sorry), and Mag. Absolutely awesome receptionists as well. Thank you for a great start to my birthday!
Ulana was fantastic. Made me feel comfortable and totally relaxed. Would definitely recommend her.

I was having some stiffness in my lower back and hips, they made sure that they worked on the areas that I had issues with. It really did make a difference I was felt relieved even it’s been days after my appointment and I still feel great. The facial was very relaxing I fell asleep towards the end from how calming it was.
It was our second go at a couples massage since we loved our first experience. This second time was just as good.
